assigned_lane: K3-CCL Catalogue-Completion Learner (self-assigned this session; recorded in research/2026-10-28-ccl.md)
hypothesis: Uncatalogued faults are the missing pieces of catalogued fault systems (tip continuations, parallel splays, linkage zones); a learner trained on simulated catalogue incompleteness with visible-catalogue geometry recovers them better than physics alone.
mechanism: HistGradientBoosting on 34 shared stack channels + 5 LiDAR scarp bands + 6 visible-catalogue geometry features (distance, along-strike vs perpendicular offset, strike alignment, density, tip distance); crest-first Poisson-disk dots d=2.8 px; catalogue collar B=5 px.
named_non_fault_process: Catalogue-proximity bias: hidden catalogue FRAGMENTS near visible traces are easy holdout targets but live new faults are depleted within ~5 px of the catalogue (live-ledger strata); lithologic contacts and flight-line levelling mimic potential-field edges.
